meta.scope: HuggingBay downloadable-programs index (every model with files on the site); the wider 170k metadata index was not included

how_downloads_work.direct: HTTPS GET https://huggingbay.xyz/api/downloads/{artifactId}/{filePath} (only files whose serve_state is READY; BLOCKED files return no bytes). Each file carries a sha256; the per-model signed manifest is /api/manifests/{artifactId} (key at /api/keys/manifest-signing).
how_downloads_work.torrent_magnet: reviewed fallback only: each artifact has decentralizedDistribution {protocol: bittorrent-magnet-metadata, verifiedFallbacks}, read via /api/artifacts/{id}/peer-fallbacks; policy noUnreviewedMagnetPublication, sampled models had 0 verified magnets. No magnet links on the page.
how_downloads_work.upstream: every model also links its Hugging Face repo (source_url)

api_endpoints.hosted_files_dump: /api/dumps/hosted-files.jsonl?limit=1000 (cursor in the Link rel=next header; covers ~2k models)

meta.hardware_fit_method: est_memory_gb = file_gb*1.08 + 0.2 (fitted to 4 measured Ollama loads on an 8 GB M3). runs = fits with the usual apps open; tight = fits with little else open, expect swap or partial GPU offload; no = will not run usefully. RAM classes measured only for 8 GB; others are scaled estimates.
meta.fields: size_bytes_site = the site's own size figure (sometimes wrong, e.g. a few KB); weight_bytes_total = sum of every listed weight file (all quants together); gguf_variants = one entry per quant with shards summed, smallest first. uncensored = site flag OR repo name matches abliterated/uncensored/heretic/dolphin; abliterated = repo name says so. parameters/quantization parsed from repo and file names (null when absent).
